I will do this wheat plot the way I can manage with my own money and hands. The plot is small, so I will put manure from home and a little chemical fertilizer if the cooperative has it, because wheat gives better when I do both. I will keep my local seed, I will not buy spray, and I will wait for the rain because I have no irrigation on this plot. Most of the work I will do with my family, and I will not hire labor.
